notifications.description: Get the notifications from the bell as browser notifications, even when MoneyMatter is closed.

serverDisabled.title: Browser notifications are not set up
serverDisabled.description: This instance has no push keys configured, so it cannot send browser notifications. Ask the administrator to set the VAPID keys.

thisDevice.title: This device
thisDevice.toggleDescription: Notifications arrive on this browser even when the tab or the whole browser is closed.
thisDevice.unsupported: This browser cannot receive push notifications. Open MoneyMatter in a current version of Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari to turn them on.
thisDevice.needsHomeScreen: Add MoneyMatter to your Home Screen first: Share → Add to Home Screen, then open it from there and turn this on.
thisDevice.denied: Notifications are blocked for this site, so the browser will not ask again.

blockedHint.chrome: Click the icon left of the address bar, open Site settings and set Notifications to Allow.
blockedHint.edge: Click the icon left of the address bar, open Permissions for this site and set Notifications to Allow.
blockedHint.firefox: Click the icon left of the address bar, clear the blocked Notifications permission, then reload the page.
blockedHint.safari: Open Safari → Settings → Websites → Notifications and set this site to Allow.
blockedHint.ios: Open Settings → Notifications → MoneyMatter and turn on Allow Notifications.
blockedHint.other: Allow notifications for this site in your browser's site settings, then reload the page.

thisDevice.tapAgain: The browser still held an older subscription. It has been removed, so turn this on again.

toasts.enabled: Notifications are on for this device
toasts.disabled: Notifications are off for this device
toasts.denied: Notifications are blocked in your browser settings
toasts.dismissed: The permission request was dismissed. Turn this on again to allow notifications.
toasts.tapAgain: Turn this on once more to finish
toasts.failed: Could not turn on notifications for this device
toasts.disableFailed: Could not turn off notifications for this device
